_readme: Accessories only (people already own the machine). One place for every affiliate link: pages link to /go/<id>, and Amazon links get site.json affiliate.amazonTag added. Don't show Amazon prices on the site: Amazon's rules require live prices from their API, so 'price' stays empty and the button says Check price.
_research: From Julian's research: CREAMi pints 4-pack ~$30 official, ~7K/mo, 6.7K reviews (top seller). Outer lid ~$20, paddle ~$24 (3rd-party $29-43), weak volume. Mix-in tool $13. Blender 24oz Sip & Seal cups 2-pack $22-25, ~2K/mo, 3K+ reviews. Extractor blades 2-pack ~$27, ~1K/mo. Kona pellet variety pack $40, 2,400+ reviews, 1K+/mo; official Ninja pellets $18. Woodfire covers: no volume data. Thermometer $23, pellet scoop $18. Juicer brush $14, jug $17: no volume data.

products.name: CREAMi pints with lids (4-pack)
products.note: Freeze tomorrow's dessert today. Pint size depends on your model, check the table below.

products.name: Outer bowl lid and paddle
products.note: A spare paddle means you can spin a second pint while the first is in the dishwasher.

products.name: Mix-in tool
products.note: Makes the hole for cookies, chips and swirls before you press Mix-In.

products.name: 24 oz cups with Sip & Seal lids (2-pack)
products.note: Blend in the cup, flip, lid on, out the door.

products.name: Extractor blade assembly (2-pack)
products.note: Fresh blades keep smoothies silky. Check it fits your cup size.

products.name: Grilling pellet variety pack
products.note: Try hickory, cherry and more to find your favourite smoke.

products.name: Ninja Woodfire pellets
products.note: Official Robust and All-purpose blends. ½ cup per cook.

products.name: Meat thermometer
products.note: The one tool that makes grilling foolproof: 165°F chicken, 145°F pork and fish.

products.name: Pellet scoop
products.note: Exactly the right amount of pellets, no mess.

products.name: Grill cover
products.note: Keeps it dry between cookouts.

products.name: Cleaning brush
products.note: Gets pulp out of the filter in seconds, the part everyone hates cleaning.

products.name: Spare juice jug
products.note: Juice two batches back to back.

products.name: Digital kitchen scale (grams)
products.note: Protein pints only work when the powder and liquid are measured. Grams beat scoops.

products.name: Extra pint lids
products.note: Lids go missing first. Keep spares so every pint in the freezer is covered.

products.name: Whey-casein blend protein powder
products.note: Blends with casein spin creamier than pure whey isolate. Pick a flavor you like as a shake.

products.name: Allulose sweetener
products.note: Keeps low-sugar pints softer than erythritol, which freezes rock-hard.

products.name: Sugar-free instant pudding mix
products.note: 1 tablespoon per pint fixes icy, crumbly protein bases.

products.name: Xanthan gum
products.note: A pinch (⅛ tsp) stops keto and dairy-free pints from turning icy.

products.name: Sugar-free chocolate chips
products.note: Stevia-sweetened chips for keto mix-ins. Chop them small so they don’t sink.

products.name: Coconut cream (canned)
products.note: The fat that makes dairy-free pints creamy instead of icy. Cream, not milk.

products.name: Plant protein powder (pea + rice)
products.note: Smoother than pure pea. Pick a flavor you’d drink as a shake.

products.name: Glass juice bottles with lids (16 oz)
products.note: Fill to the very top so there’s no air. Fresh juice keeps 48–72 hours in the fridge.

products.name: 2 oz shot bottles
products.note: Batch a week of ginger shots in one go.

products.name: Silicone freezer trays (1-cup portions)
products.note: Freeze smoothie pucks so the cup blends thick, not watery.

products.name: Unflavored pea protein
products.note: Vegan protein that disappears into fruit smoothies.

products.name: MCT oil powder
products.note: Keto fat that blends creamy. Start with 1 tbsp.

products.name: Sugar-free BBQ sauce
products.note: Won’t burn black like regular sauce and fits keto.

products.name: Flat stainless steel skewers
products.note: Flat blades stop food spinning when you flip. Check they fit the grate.

products.name: Grill basket / perforated tray
products.note: For veggies and fish that fall through the grate.
